page.overview:
Who is Skyrine?

Skyrines are the robotic troopers of S.K.A.R. They may be used either alongside or in place of normal S.K.A.R. troops. Skyrines possess a single red eye and are armed with blasters mounted to their right wrist. Skyrines are capable of flight and are water resistant.
